metadata.title: A Palantir Director Just Sold Nearly $245,000 of Stock

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Shares hover near recent highs as Palantir Technologies Inc. (PLTR, Financials) director Lauren Stat discloses stock sale. Palantir Technologies Inc., a maker of data analytics and artificial intelligence tools.Stat sold 1,342 shares at $182.50 each on Sept. 1, totaling $244,915. The transaction was executed pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading strategy that she adopted on Feb. 11, meaning the sell was organized months in advance.After the acquisition, Stat owned 52,765 shares of Palantir immediately. She also declared more indirect ownership through family accounts.The magnitude of the transaction is small compared with Palantir's roughly $400 billion-plus market capitalization, meaning the company's underlying growth is a bigger issue for investors.Palantir said it earned $1.94 billion in revenue during the second quarter, increasing 93% year-over-year. U.S. commercial revenue was up 149% to $764 million and adjusted free cash flow was $1.22 billion.The business also boosted its full-year revenue projection to $8.15 billion-$8.16 billion as demand for its AI software continues to grow.The next catalyst will be Palantir's third quarter results, when investors will want to see indicators its rapid US commercial growth can continue.
